note: Round-26 fixes. JNI dispatchStreaming / dispatchFullStreaming: a response body write that fails after the first segment of a multi-segment chunk reached the Java OutputStream now throws VesperaStreamAbortedException (it was reported as a clean error header). Cron: a failed scheduler-thread start releases its job claims, so a later start_once_for_crate retries. Validated 422 envelope messages are bounded to 256 characters (a huge path segment no longer echoes back in full). runtime_built() is false after shutdown. Resumable direct write: an event-stream 422 skips the hoist prefetch and returns pending at once. Docs corrected for the 422 prefetch, multipart 500 mapping, the stash byte budget and the mimalloc default.
